title: R.U.Z.E. comes together with N.F.U.Z.I.O.N. and lives up to the title of his new release, "Don't Call Me"
htmlContent:
American-based music star R.U.Z.E. is a multi-talented singer and songwriter currently greasing the industry with his infectious sound. The lyrical genius comes together with N.F.U.Z.I.O.N. to create a must-hear sound titled "Don't Call Me."

R.U.Z.E. and N.F.U.Z.I.O.N., on their latest single, "Don't Call Me," is a trap-inspired track with brutal rap vocals in the style of many rap images today. It is R.U.Z.E.'s first new single in a long while, and for that, it is a comeback. R.U.Z.E. is back to take his place as the next-rated artist.
